about: Hand-researched outcomes for finished Alzheimer's disease studies, used by scripts/fetch-registry.mjs. Keyed by NCT ID. verdict is one of: Met primary endpoint, Missed primary endpoint, No benefit shown (exploratory study with no formal primary endpoint), Mixed results, Inconclusive, Stopped: no benefit, Stopped: safety, Stopped: slow enrollment, Stopped: business or funding, Extension or access study, Safety study, Descriptive results (no comparison or formal test, e.g. a feasibility or physiology study), Not a treatment study, No results found. summary says what happened in plain words; source is the checked publication or report it rests on (null only for facts that are part of the registry record itself or widely documented, e.g. a drug's market withdrawal). ignorePublications: true hides publications the registry links as results when they are really background or a different study. Studies not listed here get an automatic outcome from the registry (its stop reason, posted results and linked publications).
